213: class GraphBiasAttention(nn.Module):
214:     """MHA with additive per-head bias from clamped hop distance."""
215:     def __init__(self, d_model, n_heads, max_hop=16):
216:         super().__init__()
217:         self.h = n_heads; self.dk = d_model // n_heads
218:         self.q = nn.Linear(d_model, d_model); self.k = nn.Linear(d_model, d_model)
219:         self.v = nn.Linear(d_model, d_model); self.o = nn.Linear(d_model, d_model)
220:         self.hop_emb = nn.Embedding(max_hop + 2, n_heads)  # +1 pad/unreachable bucket
221:         self.max_hop = max_hop
222: 
223:     def forward(self, x, hop, key_padding_mask=None):
224:         B, J, D = x.shape
225:         q = self.q(x).view(B, J, self.h, self.dk).transpose(1, 2)
226:         k = self.k(x).view(B, J, self.h, self.dk).transpose(1, 2)
227:         v = self.v(x).view(B, J, self.h, self.dk).transpose(1, 2)
228:         att = (q @ k.transpose(-1, -2)) / (self.dk ** 0.5)  # [B,h,J,J]
229:         hb = hop.clamp(max=self.max_hop + 1)               # [B,J,J]
230:         bias = self.hop_emb(hb).permute(0, 3, 1, 2)         # [B,h,J,J]
231:         att = att + bias
232:         if key_padding_mask is not None:
233:             att = att.masked_fill(key_padding_mask[:, None, None, :], float("-inf"))
234:         att = att.softmax(-1)
235:         out = (att @ v).transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, J, D)
236:         return self.o(out)
237:

239: class EncBlock(nn.Module):
240:     def __init__(self, d, h):
241:         super().__init__()
242:         self.a = GraphBiasAttention(d, h); self.n1 = nn.LayerNorm(d)
243:         self.ff = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(d, 4 * d), nn.GELU(), nn.Linear(4 * d, d))
244:         self.n2 = nn.LayerNorm(d)
245: 
246:     def forward(self, x, hop, kpm):
247:         x = x + self.a(self.n1(x), hop, kpm)
248:         x = x + self.ff(self.n2(x))
249:         return x

252: class CrossBlock(nn.Module):
253:     def __init__(self, d, h):
254:         super().__init__()
255:         self.mha = nn.MultiheadAttention(d, h, batch_first=True)
256:         self.n1 = nn.LayerNorm(d); self.nq = nn.LayerNorm(d)
257:         self.ff = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(d, 4 * d), nn.GELU(), nn.Linear(4 * d, d))
258:         self.n2 = nn.LayerNorm(d)
259: 
260:     def forward(self, q, kv, key_padding_mask=None):
261:         a, _ = self.mha(self.nq(q), self.n1(kv), self.n1(kv), key_padding_mask=key_padding_mask)
262:         q = q + a
263:         q = q + self.ff(self.n2(q))
264:         return q

158: def load_paired_data(cache, device, max_rows=0, sem_encoder="siglip", pose_device=None):
159:     """Load a paired cache -> per-embodiment dict. Consumes no RNG (see module doc).
160:     Manifest schema 2 lists N embodiments; legacy manifests imply [soma77, g1_name].
161:     max_rows > 0 truncates every embodiment to the first max_rows frames — SMOKE TESTS
162:     ONLY (it changes N and therefore the split); 0 = the real, unchanged path.
163:     sem_encoder picks the frozen joint-name text encoder ("siglip" 768 / "qwen3" 1024);
164:     its disk cache must already exist or the load consumes RNG and breaks the split.
165:     `cache` may be a comma list of caches with identical embodiment sets — rows are
166:     concatenated in the listed order (lafan,amass_full for the 0809 arms).
167:     pose_device: "gpu" = legacy resident-on-GPU fp32; "cpu16" = PoseStore; None = auto
168:     (cpu16 once total rows exceed 2.5M, printed loudly)."""
169:     import json, numpy as np, gc
170:     from common import SkeletonSpec
171:     caches = [c for c in str(cache).split(",") if c]
172:     man = json.load(open(f"{caches[0]}/manifest.json"))
173:     names = man.get("embodiments") or ["soma77", man["g1_name"]]
174:     # 0831 lloyd: pal_talos 的 URDF 有问题(标签侧也测到 h0=15.8cm 全场最高、
175:     # 16.9% 片段整段零接触), 整个语料层面剔除, 不训练也不当 holdout。
176:     # 覆盖用 AM_EXCLUDE_EMB=a,b (留空则不排除任何具身)。
177:     _ex = {x for x in os.environ.get("AM_EXCLUDE_EMB", "pal_talos").split(",") if x}
178:     if _ex:
179:         names = [n for n in names if n not in _ex]
180:     for c in caches[1:]:
181:         m2 = json.load(open(f"{c}/manifest.json"))
182:         n2 = m2.get("embodiments") or ["soma77", m2["g1_name"]]
183:         n2 = [n for n in n2 if n not in _ex]          # 0903: 排除表对每个缓存同样生效
184:         assert set(n2) == set(names), f"embodiment mismatch: {c}"
185:     specs = {}
186:     for name in names:
187:         d = np.load(f"{caches[0]}/{name}_spec.npz", allow_pickle=True)
188:         specs[name] = SkeletonSpec(str(d["name"]), d["parents"], d["rest_offsets"],
189:                                    list(d["joint_names"]))
190:     from semantics import build_name_embeddings, embed_matrix
191:     lut = build_name_embeddings(sum([list(specs[n].joint_names) for n in names], []),
192:                                 device=device, encoder=sem_encoder)
193:     if pose_device is None:
194:         pose_device = os.environ.get("POSE_DEVICE") or None   # smoke-test override
195:     if pose_device is None:
196:         rows0 = sum(torch.load(f"{c}/{names[0]}_paired_local6d.pt", mmap=True).shape[0]
197:                     for c in caches)
198:         pose_device = "cpu16" if (rows0 if not max_rows else min(rows0, max_rows)) > 2_500_000 \
199:             else "gpu"
200:         if pose_device == "cpu16":
201:             print(f"[load_paired_data] {rows0} rows -> pose resident fp16 on CPU "
202:                   f"(PoseStore)", flush=True)
203:     data = {}; N = None
204:     for name in names:
205:         spec = specs[name]
206:         st = static_cond(spec, device)
207:         sem = embed_matrix(spec.joint_names, lut).to(device)     # [J,D] joint-name text semantics
208:         if pose_device == "cpu16":
209:             # 0903: 5.2M 行时 build_global 的 fp32 中间量 (list+cat+pose) 一台机器人就 20+GB,
210:             # 叠在已驻留的 fp16 上被 OOM 杀 (anon-rss 50.8GB). 改成: 各缓存 mmap 读 (页缓存,
211:             # 可回收, 不 cat), 分块 FK 直接写进预分配 fp16, 两遍 FK (第一遍只求 reach).
212:             # 数值与原路径一致到 fp32 分块噪声 (build_global 自己换 chunk 也差 1e-6 比例的 1 ulp).
213:             parts = [torch.load(f"{c}/{name}_paired_local6d.pt", mmap=True) for c in caches]
214:             if max_rows: parts = [parts[0][:max_rows]]
215:             pose16, reach = build_pose16(parts, spec, device)
216:             entry = {"spec": spec, "st": st, "pose": PoseStore(pose16, device), "reach": reach, "sem": sem}
217:             l6 = local6d = gr6 = gp = pose = None; N_ = pose16.shape[0]
218:         else:
219:             l6 = torch.cat([torch.load(f"{c}/{name}_paired_local6d.pt") for c in caches]) \
220:                 if len(caches) > 1 else torch.load(f"{caches[0]}/{name}_paired_local6d.pt")
221:             local6d = l6[:max_rows].contiguous() if max_rows else l6; N_ = local6d.shape[0]
222:             gr6, gp, reach = build_global(local6d, spec, device)
223:             pose = torch.cat([gr6, gp / reach], -1)
224:             entry = {"spec": spec, "st": st, "pose": pose.to(device), "reach": reach, "sem": sem}
225:         dof_path = f"{caches[0]}/{name}_dof.npz"                 # mechanical spec (axes + limits)
226:         if os.path.exists(dof_path):
227:             entry["dof"] = torch.as_tensor(np.load(dof_path)["dof"], dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
228:             from dof_head import build_kin                       # E25: precomputed hinge kinematics
229:             entry["kin"] = build_kin(caches[0], name, spec, device=device)
230:         data[name] = entry
231:         N = N_; print(f"[{name}] J={spec.J} rows={N} reach={reach:.1f}cm sem={tuple(sem.shape)}")
232:         del l6, local6d, gr6, gp, pose
233:         gc.collect()
234:     return data, names, N
